item.text: {"case_id":"SPR00109","decision":"candidate","candidate_ranking":["C14","C21","C19"],"selected_candidate_label":"C14","confidence":0.98,"relationship_type":"both","rationale":"C14 supplies a concrete and extensive template for the child: it recites an existing section 22 quota, states that the quota has already been exhausted, describes a supplemental Tariff Commission investigation into additional imports needed by domestic users during the remainder of the quota year, finds changed circumstances, modifies the earlier proclamation to admit a specified additional quantity, and makes the same statutory noninterference finding. C21 and C19 use substantially the same machinery, but C14 is the closest overall match in the sequence and wording of the operative provisions.","shared_material":[{"child_excerpt":"the total quantity
